say:1:1641109001:1.text: Huh? My secret to good luck? Uhh... lately it feels more like mediocre luck, if I'm being honest.

say:6:1641109005:1.text: Either way, I didn't even get a bite. The forest critters carried the hazelnuts off. Then they came back later with bags of snacks as a thank-you... They probably thought I roasted them on purpose.
